scheme_name: Jharkhand Nirman Karmakar Mrityu/Durghatana Sahayata Yojana
other_conditions: Must be a registered construction worker (Nirman Shramik / Nirman Karmakar)
Must have worked for at least 90 days
benefits_summary: Provides cash assistance up to ₹5,00,000 for death, ₹3,00,000 for total disability, ₹2,00,000 for partial disability, and ₹1,00,000 for normal death.
